connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.description: Repos, issues, pull requests, and Actions.
connectors.guide:
GitHub's hosted MCP. GitHub does not register OAuth clients automatically.

Create an OAuth App at github.com/settings/developers. Authorization callback URL must be this Silo's /oauth/callback — locally http://127.0.0.1:5173/oauth/callback. Open Advanced settings, paste the Client ID and Secret, then Authorize after adding.

Or set Auth to None and add an Authorization header with a personal access token (Bearer …).

connectors.name: Linear
connectors.guide:
Linear issues, projects, and cycles.

OAuth usually registers the client automatically — leave Client ID blank, add the connector, then Authorize with your Linear workspace.

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.guide:
Notion pages, databases, and search.

OAuth usually registers the client automatically. After adding, Authorize and grant the pages this Bot may read.

connectors.name: Stripe
connectors.guide:
Stripe customers, payments, and documentation.

OAuth usually registers the client automatically. After adding, Authorize with the Stripe account this Bot should use.

connectors.name: Sentry
connectors.guide:
Sentry errors, performance, and projects.

OAuth usually registers the client automatically. After adding, Authorize with the organization this Bot should read.

connectors.name: Context7
connectors.guide:
Library documentation. Works without a key at a low rate limit.

For a higher limit, create a key at context7.com/dashboard and add a CONTEXT7_API_KEY header under Advanced settings.
